audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. the class equality in Lemma 6.2 is false
limitations: Counterevidence: The proof of Theorem1.6 on p27 already explicitly invokes direct-limit permanence of localizations and Atiyah properties. This is material support for a repair; permanence is not absent from the manuscript. It does not make the asserted identity T_VLI=Y true. The missing bridge is from the actual directed-union closure to the stated Y_alpha induction. No failure of an Atiyah conclusion, no failure of all finite-edge arguments, and no whole-paper invalidity are inferred.
Limits: Initial review is not independent acceptance.
Limits: Analytic counterexample and class repair independently derived here; native exact affine calculation is auxiliary evidence, not a finite test substituted for the infinite-group proof.
